correctness.rationale: An A first projection annihilates e0=a; conditional on exceptional B first, each switch of projection nullspace multiplies squared norm by k. For labeled rows RR gives (1−k)k/m; IID gives (1−k)G_m(k)/m with exact two-state weighted transition. G_m(0)=m^(−(m−1)), G_m(1)=1, G_m''(k)>0 for m≥3, G_m'(1)>1, so exactly one interior zero of G_m(k)−k, with the stated strict risk-reversal signs. For m=2, G=(1+k)/2>k. Splitting into zero/one/multiple switches and Poisson(1) rare exceptional future choices gives κ_m~m^(−(m−1))/(1−e^(−1)) and fixed-k ratio e^(1−k²). Independent exact word and projection enumeration m≤9/5 corroborated the theory and three distinct rational vectors gave the stated positive gap 234845527130732528/396688687243963171875.

originality.rationale: Qualitative random-reshuffling-not-always-better phenomena occur in prior SGD work (including De Sa), and IID Kaczmarz exact-MSE recurrences are classical. The assessed novelty is the exact multi-m repeated-row, full-step one-epoch expected fixed-vector risk law, unique angular threshold for every m≥3, superexponential collapse, e^(1−k²) ratio and distinct-row witness. No exact dominating theorem was identified in the inspected comparisons; residual finite-epoch specialist priority risk remains.
